source.source_locator: 教則 第2章 2.2.1(1)③「飛行計画の作成」（教則表示ページ4 / PDF viewer 10）

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 緊急着陸地点だけでなく、安全にホバリング・旋回できる場所等も含め、異常時の対策を事前設定する。
evidence.tested_misconception: 異常時対策は緊急着陸地点だけ決めれば十分である。
evidence.reasoning_path: contingency planning -> not yet forced landing -> identify safe holding/maneuvering options

collision.note: Tier B。parent=preflight contingency planning。distinct axes=decision boundary/response priority。Q044は緊急着陸地点確保、Q195は事象中の不時着優先。本問は着陸前のsafe holding/turning branchを問う。

independent_review.rationale: Tier B PASS. 2.2.1(1)3 separately names emergency landing locations and places where safe hovering/turning is possible. Q044 tests emergency landing-site availability and Q195 tests in-event landing priority; this candidate tests the preflight safe-holding/maneuvering branch before forced landing.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review correctly applies the quality-preserving 400-question contract. The 13 Tier A source propositions are explicit Chapter 2 learning targets not represented by the current canonical bank. Six Tier B variants remain materially distinct because each tests a source-defined branch, phase, recipient or condition with a different application path: C006 safe holding/turning contingency, C008 preflight traffic survey, C011 preflight sleep-debt go/no-go, C016 non-specific-flight logging recommendation, C019 emergency-recipient selection, and C020 Level 3.5 insurance as an independent OR condition. C015 is excluded because its operational action duplicates Q089. Quality takes precedence over filling the 20-candidate ceiling.
